title.narrative: Service delivery systems were strengthened through the Integrated Social Services (ISS) which was scaled to 180 districts (69% of the country), reaching 76,951 children with services, including those in humanitarian situations. In-service insitutionalised training, enforcement of standards and protocols, quality assurance measures and innovative data management approaches were enhanced.
